Trace, implement and test: Count Evens Odds

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class CountEvensOdds{
    public int countEvensOdds(int input1, int input2, int input3, int input4, int input5, String input6){
        int count = 0;
        int [] arr = {input1, input2, input3, input4, input5};
        for (int num : arr){
            if (num % 2 == 0) count++;
        }

        if (input6.equals("even")) return count;
        else return 5- count;
    }
}
